# origincloud_billing_legal_acceptances (Data Source)

Lists a billing account's acceptances, the latest first. Needs `admin.billing_account.get` on the organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `billing_account` (String) The billing account whose legal acceptances to list.
- `organization` (String) The organization whose legal acceptances to list.

### Read-Only

- `legal_acceptances` (Attributes List) The legal acceptances listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--legal_acceptances))

<a id="nestedatt--legal_acceptances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `legal_acceptances`

Read-Only:

- `accept_time` (String) When the version was accepted. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `accepter` (String) Who accepted, by its full name on iam: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/users/{user}`, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`, or a platform service agent's or service's name when the platform did.
- `acts_as_business` (Boolean) Whether the accepter confirmed acting as a business. Always true.
- `billing_address` (Attributes) The billing account's address at `accept_time`; unset for an account that had none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--legal_acceptances--billing_address))
- `id` (String) The legal acceptance's full resource name, `//billing.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/billingAccounts/{billing_account}/legalAcceptances/{legal_acceptance}`: what an argument that refers to the legal acceptance takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `legal_document_version` (String) The full name of the version accepted, `//billing.origincloudapis.eu/legalDocuments/{legal_document}/versions/{version}`.
- `method` (String) How the acceptance came about. One of `SIGNUP`, `CHANGE`, `MIGRATION`.
- `name` (String) The acceptance's resource name.
- `organization_display_name` (String) The legal entity that accepted, as it was at `accept_time`: the organization's name.
- `sha256` (String) The SHA-256 of the text accepted: the version's `sha256`.
- `vat_id` (String) The billing account's VAT identification number at `accept_time`; empty when it had none.

<a id="nestedatt--legal_acceptances--billing_address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `legal_acceptances.billing_address`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) The city.
- `postal_code` (String) The postal code.
- `region_code` (String) The country, as the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of one of the countries ListBillingCountries lists, such as `DE`.
- `street` (String) The street and house number.
